brief: Long, narrow industrial corner cafe with a full-height black-steel glazed front on one side and a glazed entry door at the far end. A raw brick wall with warm wall-washed framed black-and-white prints runs the other side, with round bentwood-chair bistro tables along it. The centre is held by one long reclaimed-wood communal table with black metal Tolix-style chairs, and a timber window bar with black metal stools lines the glass. The coffee counter sits at the back: matte-black vertical-slat front, butcher-block top, espresso machine and grinders, a lit pastry case, a chalkboard menu and open black-steel shelving with cups, bags and bottles over a glowing yellow tile backsplash. Black dome pendants and track spots hang from an exposed dark ceiling with silver ducts. Surfaces carry white cups, croissants, small flower jars and a notebook; leafy potted plants are spread throughout. Mood is warm, daylit and welcoming.

must_have.where: on the counter: espresso machine and two grinders
large framed chalkboard above the back counter
long reclaimed-wood communal table in the room centre
small round bistro tables along the brick wall
black metal chairs at the communal table plus bentwood chairs at the round tables
long timber ledge along the glazed front
black metal stools along the window bar
beside the counter, window and brick wall

concept: Warm industrial urban cafe: raw brick, black steel and polished concrete are softened by reclaimed wood, amber light and greenery, with big street windows adding daylight.
relations: Raw brick walls + wall-washed amber light + framed prints = warm texture that offsets the cold concrete floor and steel ducts
Black steel window frames, pendants, chairs, stools and counter front repeat one dark accent, which unifies the room and keeps it industrial
Reclaimed wood on the table, window ledge and counter top adds warmth against the black metal and gray concrete
Full-height glazing + dome pendants + track spots = daylight by day and a glowing room in the evening
Plants and flowers soften the hard materials, and the pastry case and backsplash glow draw the eye to the counter
Medium density with a long communal table, bistro tables and a window bar gives a social, busy-but-open layout
